source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As the first battle round begins, choose one of the battlefield's objective markers. From then until the battle ends, whenever this unit stands within range of that marker and is not Battle-shocked, its models get Objective Control 3 and a 5+ invulnerable save.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
